name: Facet
text: We should implement a single dark theme by default with a manual toggle to light mode, as this approach provides a consistent and immersive experience for users, aligning with the Manus Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard. This decision prioritizes clarity and visibility, essential for effective data visualization. By accepting a potential trade-off in flexibility, we ensure a cohesive interface that meets our quality-first principle. This approach also simplifies development, allowing us to focus on enhancing the interactive and engaging aspects of the interface.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t user preference—it’s locking ourselves into a theme system before proving it solves the core problem. A better alternative is testing *both* themes by default for a short period, then measuring engagement and clarity metrics. Settle it by running an A/B test with 50% of users seeing dark mode first, 50% seeing light mode first, and comparing retention and task completion rates.
